actions.ai_create_space.description: Create a space, or reuse the existing space with the same name.
actions.ai_create_space.props.chunkOverl: Overlap between chunks (default 25, smaller than Chunk Size)
Characters per chunk when splitting documents (default 256)
actions.ai_create_space.props.embedderId: The ID of the embedder model (from List Models)
actions.ai_create_space.props.name.descr: A unique name for the space
actions.ai_list_memories.description: List the memories stored in a space.
actions.ai_list_memories.props.filter.de: Optional metadata filter, for example val('$.source') = 'docs'
actions.ai_list_memories.props.nextToken: The nextToken from a previous call, to fetch the following page
actions.ai_list_memories.props.spaceId.d: The ID of the space whose memories to list (from List Spaces)
actions.ai_list_models.description: List the embedders, rerankers and LLMs configured on the GoodMem server.
actions.ai_list_models.props.kind.descri: Which kind of model to list
actions.ai_retrieve_memories.description: Semantic search over one or more spaces.
actions.ai_retrieve_memories.props.llmId: Optional LLM ID that generates an answer from the retrieved chunks
actions.ai_retrieve_memories.props.query: The natural-language question or text to search for
actions.ai_retrieve_memories.props.relev: Minimum score (0-1); only applied when a reranker or LLM is set
actions.ai_retrieve_memories.props.space: IDs of the spaces to search
actions.ai_retrieve_memories.props.waitF: yes = retry for up to 60 seconds when nothing is found yet
actions.ai_store_memory.description: Store text as a new memory in a space.
actions.ai_store_memory.props.author.des: Author of the content, stored in metadata.author
actions.ai_store_memory.props.metadata.d: Extra key-value metadata as a JSON object
actions.ai_store_memory.props.source.des: Where the content came from, stored in metadata.source
actions.ai_store_memory.props.spaceId.de: The ID of the space to store the memory in
actions.create_memory.description: Store a document as a new memory in a space. The memory is processed asynchronously - chunked into searchable pieces and embedded into vectors. Accepts a file or plain text.
actions.create_memory.props.author.descr: The author or creator of the content. Stored in metadata.author
actions.create_memory.props.file.descrip: A file to store as memory (PDF, DOCX, image, etc.). Connect the output of a trigger or action that provides a file. Content type is auto-detected from the file extension.
actions.create_memory.props.metadata.des: Extra key-value metadata as JSON. Merged with Source, Author, and Tags fields above
actions.create_memory.props.source.descr: Where this memory came from (e.g., "google-drive", "gmail", "manual upload"). Stored in metadata.source
actions.create_memory.props.tags.descrip: Comma-separated tags for categorization (e.g., "legal,research,important"). Stored in metadata.tags as an array
Plain text content to store as memory (sent as text/plain). If both File and Text Content are provided, the file takes priority.
actions.create_space.description: Create a new space or reuse an existing one. A space is a logical container for organizing related memories, configured with embedders that convert text to vector embeddings
actions.create_space.props.embedderId.de: The embedder model that converts text into vector representations for similarity search
actions.create_space.props.name.descript: A unique name for the space. If a space with this name already exists, its ID will be returned instead of creating a duplicate
actions.delete_memory.description: Permanently delete a memory and its associated chunks and vector embeddings.
actions.delete_memory.props.memoryId.des: The UUID of the memory to delete (returned by Create Memory)
actions.get_memory.description: Fetch a specific memory record by its ID, including metadata, processing status, and optionally the original content.
Fetch the original document content of the memory in addition to its metadata
actions.get_memory.props.memoryId.descri: The UUID of the memory to fetch (returned by Create Memory)
actions.list_spaces.description: List the spaces in your GoodMem account, optionally filtered by name.
actions.list_spaces.props.name.descripti: Only return spaces whose name matches this glob, e.g. project-*
actions.list_spaces.props.nextToken.desc: The nextToken from a previous call, for the next page
actions.retrieve_memories.description: Perform similarity-based semantic retrieval across one or more spaces. Returns matching chunks ranked by relevance, with optional full memory definitions.
actions.retrieve_memories.props.chronolo: Reorder results by creation time instead of relevance score
actions.retrieve_memories.props.includeM: Fetch the full memory metadata (source document info, processing status) alongside the matched chunks
actions.retrieve_memories.props.llmId.de: Optional LLM to generate contextual responses alongside retrieved chunks
actions.retrieve_memories.props.llmTempe: Creativity setting for LLM generation (0-2). Only used when LLM ID is set.
actions.retrieve_memories.props.maxResul: Limit the number of returned memories
actions.retrieve_memories.props.query.de: A natural language query used to find semantically similar memory chunks
actions.retrieve_memories.props.relevanc: Minimum score (0-1) for including results. Only used when Reranker or LLM is set.
actions.retrieve_memories.props.reranker: Optional reranker model to improve result ordering
actions.retrieve_memories.props.spaceIds: Select one or more spaces to search across
actions.retrieve_memories.props.waitForI: Retry for up to 60 seconds when no results are found. Enable this when memories were just added and may still be undergoing chunking and embedding
auth.description: Connect to your GoodMem API instance for vector-based memory storage and semantic retrieval
auth.props.apiKey.description: Your GoodMem API key for authentication (X-API-Key)
auth.props.baseUrl.description: The base URL of your GoodMem API server (e.g., https://api.goodmem.ai or http://localhost:8080)
description: Store documents as memories with vector embeddings and perform similarity-based semantic retrieval using GoodMem
